classification.difficultyReason: Construct a sum and a difference of two given vectors on square grids.

content.prompt: Given each set of vectors $\underset{\sim}{a}$ and $\underset{\sim}{b}$, draw:

spec.description: Eight-by-eight square grid with two labelled vectors sharing a tail. TikZ is required because the blank-grid template cannot express the supplied vectors.
spec.mathematics: Common tail (6,0); a ends at (0,5), b at (7,3). Thus a moves six left and five up; b moves one right and three up.

spec.description: One continuous square-cell drawing grid spanning the two response regions. House grid proportions replace uncertain source physical dimensions.
spec.mathematics: Twenty-four columns and nine rows; left half serves c and right half serves d.

sizing.reason: Source13 uses equal physical units between supplied and response grids. Restore full24x9 response to4.5mm cells;45:110 native row allocation enlarges writing area from actual86x32.5mm to109.2x41.7mm; all24x9 cells retained.

answer.short: An arrow 5 squares left and 8 squares up.
answer.worked: Place a copy of $\underset{\sim}{b}$ at the tip of $\underset{\sim}{a}$. Draw the resultant from the first tail to the final tip. Horizontally, move $6-1=5$ squares left; vertically, move $5+3=8$ squares up.

answer.short: An arrow 7 squares left and 2 squares up.
answer.worked: Use $\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b}=\underset{\sim}{a}+(-\underset{\sim}{b})$. Reverse $\underset{\sim}{b}$ and place it tip to tail after $\underset{\sim}{a}$. Draw the resultant from the first tail to the final tip. Move $6+1=7$ squares left and $5-3=2$ squares up.

spec.description: One complete shared answer grid, with the steep resultant in the left region and the shallow resultant in the right region.
spec.mathematics: Left arrow displacement (-5,8); right arrow displacement (-7,2).
